description:
Look up a company by CIK to get its name(s), ticker(s) and industry.

When known, the result also has the SEC's SIC classification: sic (4-digit code, e.g. "6200"),
sic_description (e.g. "SECURITY & COMMODITY BROKERS, DEALERS, EXCHANGES & SERVICES"),
sic_url (a page listing the other companies in the same industry), fiscal_year_end (MMDD, e.g.
"1231" for 31 December) and state_of_incorporation. SIC is the SEC's own scheme and is not GICS;
individuals and most funds have none.

succession_filing, when present, is an 8-K12B or 8-K12G3 from the last five years in which this
company says it succeeded an earlier registrant; its older history may be under that
predecessor's CIK (see search_companies).

Args:
    cik: Central Index Key (e.g. "0000320193" or "320193")
name: get_company
title: Get Company
